image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate surrounded by purple coralline algae and orange sponges. The chiton has an oval, dorsoventrally flattened body with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The plates are greyish-brown with mottled patterns.
